dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the mid-dorsal region display dark outer perimeters with irregular, undulating boundaries. These perimeters exhibit a radial gradient transitioning from low-intensity exterior to high-intensity interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Spatial density of low-intensity solid blobs is highest in the cranial and caudal regions. High-intensity pixel concentrations are distributed as a background field, with the highest density observed at the transition between the lateral and ventral surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A cluster of four prominent annuli centroids on the mid-lateral surface forms an asymmetrical trapezoidal relationship. Three larger dorsal markings form an obtuse triangle with the longest side oriented parallel to the spinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Continuous network of high-intensity channels connecting the centers of individual annuli, creating a complex tessellated visual structure.
